challengeResponse.challengerAppearanceSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <defs>
    <filter id="texture">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.05" numOctaves="3" result="noise"/>
      <feDiffuseLighting in="noise" lighting-color="#8B4513" surfaceScale="2">
        <feDistantLight azimuth="45" elevation="60"/>
      </feDiffuseLighting>
      <feComposite in2="SourceGraphic" operator="in"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <g id="tank-body" transform="translate(256, 256)">
    <!-- Tracks -->
    <g id="tracks">
      <rect x="-160" y="-140" width="60" height="280" rx="15" fill="#5D4037"/>
      <rect x="100" y="-140" width="60" height="280" rx="15" fill="#5D4037"/>
      <g fill="#A1887F" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="4">
        <path d="M-130 -120 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M-130 -60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M-130 0 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M-130 60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 -120 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 -60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 0 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
        <path d="M130 60 a15 15 0 1 0 0 30 a15 15 0 1 0 0 -30"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Chassis Body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="110" ry="140" fill="#8B4513" filter="url(#texture)"/>
    <path d="M-90 -50 C-120 -20, -120 20, -90 50 M90 -50 C120 -20, 120 20, 90 50" fill="none" stroke="#6D4C41" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Toilet Paper Rolls -->
    <rect x="-140" y="-40" width="20" height="80" rx="5" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#D7CCC8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="120" y="-40" width="20" height="80" rx="5" fill="#FFF8E1" stroke="#D7CCC8" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Rear Flap -->
    <rect x="-30" y="110" width="60" height="30" rx="5" fill="#795548"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="125" r="8" fill="#5D4037" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M-5 120 l10 10 M-5 130 l10 -10" stroke="#EF5350" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- Turret -->
    <g id="turret">
      <path d="M-40 20 Q-50 -40 0 -60 Q50 -40 40 20 Z" fill="#795548"/>
      <!-- Eyes -->
      <circle cx="-15" cy="-20" r="12" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="-15" cy="-20" r="4" fill="black"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="-35" r="12" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="-35" r="4" fill="black"/>
      <!-- Tears -->
      <path d="M25 -25 Q30 -10 25 0" stroke="#81D4FA" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
      <!-- Corn Antenna -->
      <path d="M0 -60 L0 -80" stroke="#8D6E63" stroke-width="4"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="-85" r="8" fill="#FDD835"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Main Cannon -->
    <path d="M-10 -50 Q-20 -150 0 -180" fill="none" stroke="#5D4037" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Duck -->
    <g transform="translate(0, -180) rotate(-20)">
      <path d="M-15 -10 h30 v15 q0 10 -10 10 q-10 0 -10 -10 z" fill="#FFEB3B"/>
      <path d="M-15 0 q-10 0 -10 -5" fill="none" stroke="#FFEB3B" stroke-width="5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Exhaust -->
    <circle cx="-60" cy="100" r="10" fill="#3E2723"/>
    <circle cx="-65" cy="115" r="6" fill="#B3E5FC" opacity="0.6"/>
    <circle cx="-75" cy="125" r="4" fill="#B3E5FC" opacity="0.4"/>
  </g>
</svg>
challengeResponse.defenderAppearanceSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="metal" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#888;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#ccc;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#666;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="stone" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4a4a5e;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#2e2e3a;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Manhole Cover Base -->

  <!-- Castle Body -->
  <rect x="206" y="206" width="100" height="100" rx="10" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- Crenelations -->
  <rect x="206" y="190" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="246" y="190" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="286" y="190" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <rect x="206" y="302" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="246" y="302" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="286" y="302" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="190" y="206" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="190" y="246" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="190" y="286" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="302" y="206" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="302" y="246" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="302" y="286" width="20" height="20" fill="url(#stone)" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Turret -->
  <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="40" fill="#5a5a70" stroke="#1a1a24" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- Crossbow Barrel -->
  <rect x="248" y="120" width="16" height="136" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" rx="2"/>
  <!-- Crossbow arms -->
  <rect x="180" y="140" width="152" height="12" fill="#5a4230" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" rx="2"/>
  <!-- String line -->
  <path d="M185 146 L248 125 L311 146" fill="none" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Symbol: A simplified halberd silhouette in center -->
  <path d="M256 230 L256 280 M240 240 L272 240 M248 230 L256 220 L264 230 Z" stroke="#a0a0a0" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>

</svg>
